segments.title: Pandas eat SO much bamboo!
segments.say: {zh:你好!} That means hello! I'm Mei from Chengdu, China. Let's meet the giant panda!

segments.title: Up to 100 pounds a day!
segments.say: A giant panda eats seventy to one hundred pounds of bamboo every single day!

segments.title: A secret thumb!
segments.say: Pandas have a special wrist bone that works like a thumb, to grip bamboo.

segments.title: How big is a baby panda?
segments.say: How big is a newborn panda? A cat, a stick of butter, or a puppy? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: A stick of butter!
segments.say: A stick of butter! Newborn cubs are tiny.
